name: Simply Salt Partners
googleShortDescription: Book salt deliveries, track referral rewards, and request company stickers.
description:
Salt Partners helps technicians at Simply Salt partner companies refer customers for water softener salt delivery.

Choose your company and verify your mobile number to create an account. Returning technicians open their saved company workspace automatically. New memberships require a company invitation or Simply Salt approval.

Find delivery times, submit a customer-authorized booking, and follow your referral from pending delivery to earned reward and recorded payout. Save your own Venmo, Zelle, or Apple Cash destination so Simply Salt can pay you separately. The app does not transfer money or collect bank passwords or card numbers.

Request approved company partnership stickers at no charge and follow their fulfillment status. Illustrative tank images show how stickers could look; they are separate from approved print artwork.

Explore a clearly labeled sample workspace before joining. Sample actions do not create deliveries, send messages, order stickers, or transfer money.

Salt Partners is for technicians at participating businesses. Delivery availability depends on the customer’s service address. US mobile verification is required for a real partner account.
targetAudienceSuggestion: Adults working at partner companies; not directed to children
